scan.title: Build your 3D face
scan.intro: Turn your head. Capture your own face.
scan.prepare: Keep the camera steady, with your face, hair and ears in frame and soft light in front. You can capture just one side, without filming the back of your head. Keep a neutral expression during turns; expressions are captured separately.
scan.rgbNotice: The web preview estimates a coarse face surface. It does not reconstruct hair, ears or a complete head. Original views are retained for comparison and future reconstruction.
scan.deviceAdvice: A webcam does not measure depth. The existing iPhone face mesh is also not a detailed head scan. Neither output is a completed head reconstruction.
scan.privacy: No microphone. Frames, geometry and expressions stay on this device. Only an explicit export creates a transferable file. This is not identity verification.
scan.surfaceNotice: A coarse face surface, missing hair, ears and the back of the head. Capture lighting remains baked in; makeup gloss responds to viewing angle, but the material is not calibrated skin reflectance.

steps.blink: Face forward, close your eyes, then reopen
steps.mouth: Face forward, open your mouth, then close
steps.finish: Face forward once more and relax
steps.leftProfile: Optional: turn a little further left; skip if uncomfortable or tracking is lost
steps.rightProfile: Optional: turn a little further right; skip if uncomfortable or tracking is lost

feedback.hold: Hold the pose until the progress bar fills
feedback.starting: Starting camera and local face model…
feedback.noFace: Keep your entire face in view
feedback.oneFace: Only one face may be in the frame
feedback.center: Center your entire face in the frame
feedback.dark: Too dark — face an even light source
feedback.bright: Too bright — avoid direct harsh light
feedback.blur: Image is soft — hold still and clean the lens
feedback.level: Keep your head upright without tilting sideways
feedback.relax: Open your eyes, close your mouth and relax
feedback.building: Fusing neutral geometry and multiple texture views…
feedback.secure: Camera access requires HTTPS or localhost
feedback.denied: Camera permission denied. Allow it in browser settings, then retry
feedback.cameraError: Camera unavailable. Close other camera apps and retry
feedback.detectorError: Local face model failed to load. Check model files and retry
feedback.interrupted: Camera stopped when this page went into the background. Start again
feedback.buildError: Could not process this model. Check the file or capture again
feedback.adjustPose: Adjust gently following the instruction above. You can skip the profile step if it is difficult.
feedback.performAction: Perform the action above; relax your face once it is detected.

scan.referenceNotice: These are captured photographs, not a full 3D head. Hair and ears remain in the photos; the 3D preview still covers the face only.
scan.measuredSurfaceNotice: Measured visible regions only. Unseen areas remain missing; hair strands and hidden ear folds are not reconstructed. Expressions are not applied to this measured surface.
scan.skipProfile: Cannot track this angle — continue without it

capture.title: Capture your head, naturally
capture.subtitle: Keep a complete video. No pose checkpoints or 90-degree turns.
capture.frontHint: Look at the camera and pause naturally

turn.left: Slowly turn left as far as feels comfortable
turn.right: Slowly turn right as far as feels comfortable

capture.returnHint: Return to the front; finish whenever you are ready
capture.keepRecording: Move naturally. Blinking or briefly losing tracking will not erase your recording.
capture.coverageNotice: These are face-pose candidates, not verified coverage of ears, hair or the back of your head. Review the video to check framing.
capture.unsaved: Local storage failed. The video is still in memory; download it before leaving this page.
capture.addTitle: Record only what you want to add
capture.instructions: Face the camera, slowly turn to one comfortable side, then return. No exact angle, blink or mouth challenge is required.
capture.framing: Use even light and include the top and sides of your hair. Keep a natural expression. No audio is recorded.
capture.recordingLimit: Up to 25 seconds per clip and {{count}} clips. Finish earlier whenever you like.
capture.available: Front and turned-view candidates are available. Detailed reconstruction quality still needs model validation.
capture.incomplete: Your material is saved. Some angles have no clear candidates yet; add a clip without restarting.
capture.deleteNotice: This removes all clips and candidates in this local capture. Export anything you want to keep first.
capture.modelPending: The new detailed reconstruction service is not connected yet. This is source capture material, not a new model made from the old coarse face estimate.
capture.budget: Current trial limits: $20 total and a target wait of 5 minutes. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
capture.importNotice: Accepts .makeupcapture packages from this workflow. Export and clear an existing capture before importing another one.
capture.privacy: No login required. This workspace stays in this browser and does not sync with an account. Clearing site data removes the capture.
capture.entry: New video capture · no login required

feedback.starting: Video is recording; preparing automatic frame selection…
feedback.analysisUnavailable: Frame selection is unavailable. The original video is still recording and can be saved.
feedback.noFace: No face detected just now. Bring your head back into the frame; recording continues.
feedback.oneFace: Try to keep only yourself in the frame. Recording continues.
feedback.framing: Move back slightly and leave room above and beside your head.
feedback.lighting: Face a soft light and avoid very dark or overexposed areas.
feedback.blur: Turn a little more slowly for a clearer image.
feedback.expression: Natural blinking is fine; neutral frames will be selected automatically.
feedback.pose: Turn back slightly and stay comfortable. No fixed angle is required.
feedback.denied: Camera permission was denied. Allow access and retry.
feedback.secure: Open this page on localhost or HTTPS.
feedback.unsupported: Video recording is unsupported here. Try a current Chrome or Safari browser.
feedback.cameraError: Cannot open the camera. Check whether another app is using it.
feedback.recorderError: Recording was interrupted. Attempting to preserve recorded material.
